scripts.build: npm run types && npm run gates && tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --minify --outfile=dist/app.js && cp src/app.css dist/app.css && cp src/index.html dist/index.html
scripts.gates: cd .. && cargo rustc -q --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release --crate-type cdylib && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/best_of_n.wasm view/dist/gates.wasm
